notes.scope: Aave V3 Ethereum Core borrowers (debt > 0) whose dominant collateral (largest USD among collateral-enabled aToken balances) is WETH. Candidates = unique onBehalfOf of Pool Supply events with reserve in {WETH} (eth_getLogs, blocks 22901858..23549824) plus 33 extra candidates from data/oct10-liquidated.json, pre-filtered by getUserConfiguration (borrowing any reserve AND a target enabled as collateral). Holders who only received the aToken by transfer are not covered. Candidate window limited to the last 648000 blocks (~90 days, from block 22901825) because the full Supply history is very large; positions whose owner has not supplied WETH in that window are missed.
notes.selfDebtFilter: Excluded 392 WETH-dominant positions (debt $70,466,061, collateral $107,878,802) whose ETH-correlated (reserves 0:WETH, 1:wstETH, 7:cbETH, 9:rETH, 28:weETH, 29:osETH, 31:ETHx, 36:rsETH, 50:tETH, 51:ezETH) debt is >= 10% of their total debt: Kaskad shocks the collateral price with debt fixed in USD, but a WETH price move would move both sides of such a loop. Nothing else is subtracted.
notes.syntheticId: collateralId is the synthetic Kaskad id 7 ("WETH on Ethereum") for every position; the real Aave Ethereum reserve index is ethReserveId (0). debtByAsset keys are Ethereum reserve indices (see ethReserves).
notes.cap: Dropped 636 dust positions with debt < $100 (total debt $9,897) first. Kept the top 4640 of 4640 WETH-dominant positions by debtUsd; dropped 0. Kept positions hold 100.00% of the WETH-dominant debt ($1,782,844,825 of $1,782,854,722).
notes.hfModel: hfModel = (collateralUsd + otherCollateralUsd) * ltBps / 1e4 / debtUsd, i.e. the dominant collateral's LT applied to ALL collateral (MVP approximation). hfOnchain = Pool.getUserAccountData.healthFactor / 1e18.
notes.ltRule: ltBps/bonusBps: eMode category values if user eMode > 0 and dominant asset is in the category collateralBitmap (aave-v3-origin GenericLogic/LiquidationLogic), else reserve values. bonusBps is the extra part (10400 -> 400). See totals.ltBreakdown.
notes.totals: totals.collateralUsd/debtUsd are over the kept positions (collateralUsd includes otherCollateralUsd; byAsset collateralUsd = dominant collateral only). totals.reserveSuppliedUsd = WETH aToken totalSupply on Aave Ethereum Core (all suppliers); reserveDebtUsd = 0 (not used by the consumer). totals.all* = before the cap.
notes.depth: depth = Ethereum DEX exit liquidity for WETH (GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd sum, TVL proxy) with DefiLlama cross-check, same format as data/depth.json entries.

depth.note: Sum of GeckoTerminal reserve_in_usd over 16 Ethereum DEX pool(s) (GeckoTerminal top-pools page(s) 1..3); largest: crvUSD / WETH / CRV on curve ($993,971,355). TVL proxy (both sides of each pool), not a slippage curve. Only pools with a USD stablecoin on the other side are counted (read 3 GeckoTerminal page(s)); skipped 44 non-stable pools worth $992,780,776 (largest: ZEC / WETH 0.3% @ uniswap_v3 $312,381,735; PONS / WETH 0.3% @ uniswap_v3 $202,749,059; DEBIT / WETH 0.3% @ uniswap_v3 $95,342,001). WETH unwraps 1:1 to ETH instantly; the liquidator must sell ETH for stablecoins, so the exit is the ETH/stable DEX market (plus CEXs, not counted). DefiLlama (yields.llama.fi) Ethereum DEX pools containing WETH: 1678 pools, $1,521,130,173 total; top: uniswap-v2 WISE-WETH $152,522,297; uniswap-v3 WETH-USDT $110,561,721 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $98,609,078 (0.05%); curve-dex OETH-WETH $57,182,108; curve-dex CRVUSD-WETH $54,641,187; uniswap-v3 USDC-WETH $46,918,379 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 WBTC-WETH $44,490,780 (0.3%); uniswap-v3 WBTC-WETH $41,646,404 (0.05%). Non-DEX venues using it (lending / Pendle / vaults; not spot exit liquidity): sky-lending $790,501,384; aave-v3 $786,934,777; sky-lending $721,370,133; sparklend $304,049,844; liquity-v1 $193,919,892; compound-v3 $158,891,494.
